title: Public landing page
purpose: First view a visitor lands on. Presents brand, service lanes, sign-in / register CTAs.
fields: Portal logo + name. Clickable — always returns to '/'.
Public list of open tenders. No login required.
Vendor self-registration entry (Section A of the wizard).
Unified login card — pick admin / vendor / staff.
EN · RU · KK. Persists in localStorage.
tutorial: Navigate to https://www.pmcmanagers.com/ in any modern browser.
Click the EN pill top-right → RU or KK. Text re-flows instantly.
Click 'Notices' → any card opens the detail view.
Click 'Register' → land on Section A of the wizard.
pitfalls: Draft notices never appear here — only status=published are visible.
errors: If the language pill only shows English, the i18n bundle failed — hard-refresh (Ctrl+F5).

title: Public notice board
purpose: Browsable directory of every published tender / RFP / RFQ across all tenants.
fields: Title · closing date · budget · country · CTA 'View'.
'No open tenders match your filters' — friendly copy with a Reset button.
tutorial: Country → IN → list refreshes without page reload.
Click any card → detail page opens with description + downloads + QA thread.
pitfalls: Closed tenders still show but with a 'CLOSED' pill — participation buttons are disabled.

title: Public notice detail
purpose: Every field of a single tender, downloads, QA thread and 'Bid now' CTA.
fields: Full HTML body composed via Tender Builder.
Public question/answer log — answers appear only after admin publishes them.
tutorial: QA thread → 'Ask a question' → type ≥ 10 chars → Submit. Admin will publish the answer.
pitfalls: Corrigenda (amendments) are shown under a 'History' expander — always read them before bidding.

title: Vendor registration · Section A — Identity
purpose: Entry point of the 5-section KYC wizard. Section A captures identity + primary contact.
fields: Legal name as per registration certificate. Required.
First + last name of primary contact.
Primary email — must be unique per tenant.
ISO-2. Determines the KYC doc catalog in Section D.
Creates a silent draft and emails a resume-token.
tutorial: Enter all fields → Save & continue. Draft is created.
Backend mails a resume-token URL to the primary email.
pitfalls: Losing the resume email = start over. Admin can re-issue via Registrations panel.
Country change mid-flow re-loads the Section D doc catalog and clears prior D uploads.

title: Vendor registration · Status check
purpose: Any vendor with the emailed resume-token can check status without logging in.
fields: Paste the 24-char URL-safe token from the email.
tutorial: Toast surfaces 'Token invalid or expired' (Bug 7 fix).
Result card renders stage banner + latest reviewer note.

title: Public product roadmap
purpose: Client-visible feature roadmap. Fed from the admin roadmap module.

title: Unified login card
purpose: Single entry point offering Admin / Vendor / Staff login lanes.
tutorial: Click the card matching the account you were issued.
Once picked, the choice is remembered in localStorage for next visit.

title: Admin login page
purpose: Master admin + reviewer credential login. HTTPOnly cookie + CSRF double-submit.
fields: Sends recover-token email; token TTL 30 min.
tutorial: Email + password → Sign in → redirect to /admin within ~1s.
Toast shows backend error. 5 fails → 15-min lockout.
pitfalls: Stale cookies from another tenant — log out first (avatar → Sign out).
errors: 401 Invalid credentials · 429 Too many attempts (retry in 15 min) · 403 CSRF missing.

title: Vendor login page
purpose: Approved vendors sign in with email + password to reach the vendor portal.
fields: Vendor primary email (must match approved registration).
Set via activation email after Registration is approved.
tutorial: Email + password → Sign in → land on /vendor within 1s.
If must_change_password=true, you are forced to /vendor/change-password before anything else.
api: Sets vendor session cookie + returns csrf_token.
errors: 401 Invalid email or password · 403 Vendor account disabled (contact admin).

title: Staff login page
purpose: Escrow · Certifier · Legal · Accounting · Committee · Support · Auditor login lane.
fields: Staff email seeded in Masters → Staff.
Select the role you are signing in as (multi-role staff).
6-digit TOTP if MFA is enabled for that account.
errors: 422 active_role invalid — must be one of: admin, reviewer, escrow_agent, certifier, legal_counsel, accounting, committee_member, auditor, support.

title: Mobile login
purpose: Compact login card sized for narrow (<420 px) viewports. Same auth endpoints as desktop.

title: Admin console · Analytics dashboard
purpose: The operations overview — KPI tiles, pipeline funnel, top-priced bids, AI anomaly copilot, drill-through cards.
fields: Published notices · Vendors · Bids · Awarded · Pending EMD · EMD collected · Active contracts.
Count of bids flagged by GPT anomaly scoring. Click to drill.
Bids across every stage. Click to drill.
Top-10 by price. Click to drill.
Per-stage counts: emd_pending → emd_paid → escrow_accepted → admin_flagged → certifier_cleared → legal_cleared → accounting_cleared → awarded.
Pick a bid → 'Run AI check' → GPT flags outliers.
tutorial: Every tile is clickable → drills into the underlying list.
Scroll to the AI bid anomaly check widget → pick a bid → 'Run AI check'. Result appears inline in ~4s.
Click any card in the top row (Anomaly / Pipeline / Top-Priced) → drill card table appears with each source record.
api: Runs GPT anomaly check on a single bid.
pitfalls: The KPI numbers are tenant-scoped — if you switch tenant, refresh.
AI check requires an EMERGENT_LLM_KEY server-side; missing key returns 503.

title: Analytics · Drill · AI anomalies
purpose: Drill card of AI-flagged anomalous bids with reason strings.
fields: PMC-BID-YYYY-#### — click to open the bid drawer.
GPT-generated one-liner e.g. 'price 60% below cluster median'.

title: Analytics · Drill · Pipeline aging
purpose: Drill card of every bid grouped by pipeline stage, sorted by dwell time.

title: Analytics · Drill · Top vendors
purpose: Top-performing vendors by award count in the current period.

title: Admin console · Registrations pipeline
purpose: Every vendor registration in every stage — Draft / Submitted / Approved / Rejected / Clarification.
fields: Marks status=approved. Vendor gets activation email + must_change_password=true.
Requires a reason ≥ 5 chars. Vendor gets a rejection email.
Emails the vendor a note ≥ 5 chars. Vendor uses the resume token to re-enter.
tutorial: Click Submitted tab → pick a row → 'Approve' → confirm.
Click Submitted tab → pick a row → 'Reject' → type reason ≥ 5 chars → Confirm.
pitfalls: Approve sends the activation email via Resend; missing EMAIL_KEY = no email + no error.
Rejected drafts are purged after 90 days by a nightly job.

title: Admin console · Vendors master
purpose: Approved vendors master table with Bulk Invite CSV + Add & Fill Full Form + Invite Vendor + Replace Registration Template.
fields: Upload a new PDF template used for all future registrations.
Upload a CSV of primary emails; duplicate rows return per-row 409 without aborting.
Admin-side create — for onboarding an existing partner in one shot.
Send a magic-link invitation email to a single vendor.
Substring match on name + ref + email.
Company · vendor_ref · email · country · verify status pill.
Right pane — pick a vendor to see award counts + on-time delivery %.
tutorial: Prepare a CSV: primary_email,company_name,country. Click 'Bulk invite (CSV)' → drop file → confirm. Backend returns per-row 200/409.
Click any row → right pane populates with awards + fulfilment + blacklist status.
Row → drawer → GDPR Forget. Data is anonymised in-place, PII masked.
pitfalls: GDPR forget is IRREVERSIBLE — no undo. Always confirm the vendor_ref twice.
Bulk invite dedupes by primary email per tenant — a vendor already registered under a different tenant is NOT a duplicate.

title: Vendors · Bulk invite modal
purpose: Modal that accepts a CSV of vendor invites and returns a per-row 200/409 report.
fields: First 20 rows shown; every row gets a green tick / red cross after Submit.
Fires the invites in the background — you can leave the modal open.
pitfalls: A single malformed row does NOT abort the batch — but the row is skipped and returned with status=422.

title: Admin console · Notices
purpose: Notices master + filter bar. Every tender / RFP / RFQ starts and ends here.
fields: Slides down the create-form. Only visible if you have 'notices.create'.
Search text · status pill · document-type pill · budget currency filter · template-linked toggle.
notice_ref · title · status pill · deadline · budget · country.
tutorial: Type 3+ chars in the search box → list filters live.
Filter to drafts older than 5 days
Status → draft. Look at 'Days since created' — anything > 5d is review-worthy.
Click the row → drawer opens with Corrigenda tab + attachments + committee refs.
pitfalls: You cannot edit a published notice — issue a Corrigendum instead.
budget_amount validates ge=0. Negative returns 400 (Bug 4 fix).
notice_ref is auto-generated per tenant per year — never edit it.

title: Notices · Create notice form
purpose: The + New notice form. Every field on it, with validation rules.
fields: Free text — used for search filters.
Two mutually exclusive inputs. If percentage, base is budget_amount.
Pick from Masters → Matrix. Required to publish.
Pick from Tender Builder. Required for tender / rfp.
Master Admin only. If checked, status becomes 'published' on save.
PDF ≤ 10 MB. Required for tender / rfp.
tutorial: Fill every required field → leave Publish unchecked → 'Create'.
Same form → tick 'Publish immediately' (visible only to Master Admin) → Create.
errors: 400 budget_amount < 0 · 400 description too short · 403 role can't publish · 409 duplicate template link.

title: Admin console · Corrigenda
purpose: Formal amendments to published notices. Every change is auditable, capped at 3 withdrawals per notice.
fields: ≥ 20 chars. Written as if a lawyer will read it.
Sends notification to all subscribed bidders + updates public notice history.
Reversal action; withdrawal reason ≥ 5 chars is mandatory.
pitfalls: 4th corrigendum on the same notice returns 400 'withdrawal capped at 3' — pattern encourages issuing one comprehensive amendment.

title: Admin console · Tender Builder
purpose: Template builder. Compose reusable tender / RFP / RFQ templates: sections + annexures + header form + AI drafter + version history.
fields: Tender / RFP / RFQ. Determines the section catalog.
Read-only reference templates (e.g. 'Standard PSU e-Tender (GFR 2017, QCBS 70/30)'). 'Clone as draft' to seed.
Editable drafts owned by the tenant.
Every save is versioned; you can restore any prior version.
Renders the composed template to PDF for offline review.
EN / RU / KK for PDF export.
Only allowed on drafts you own.
tutorial: Pick 'Standard PSU e-Tender' → 'Clone as draft' → new draft appears in 'Your drafts'.
Right pane → '+ Add' → pick section type (Instructions / Eligibility / Scope / Evaluation / GCC / SCC / Annexure).
Focus a section → 'AI draft' menu → pick a preset. GPT drafts the clause; you review and Save.
pitfalls: Deleting a draft that is linked to a notice returns 409 — unlink first.
Bulk upload accepts .docx only; unsupported files are skipped with per-file 415.

title: Admin console · Bidding operations
purpose: Bid pipeline + Committee UX (checkbox grid, dissolve, resend invite, assign certifier).
fields: By status pill or by notice_ref.
Bid ref · vendor · notice · price · pipeline stage · action buttons.
Every existing committee for the current notice — expand to see members + status.
Modal — pick a certifier user + notes.
Runs GPT compare of top bids.
tutorial: Change filter → only escrow_accepted bids remain visible.
Pick two bids → 'AI compare' → drawer with side-by-side matrix.
Row → 'Assign certifier' → pick user → notes → Confirm. Certifier gets an email.

title: Bidding · New committee form
purpose: Committee create form — the checkbox grid across all roles, quorum picker, chair.
fields: Which notice this committee is for.
Every staff user × every role. Tick each cell that applies.
One member marked as chair. Chair casts the tie-breaker vote.
Number of members required for a valid decision. Default = 3.
Persists + sends invite emails to every member.
tutorial: Fill name → tick 5 members → pick a chair → quorum=3 → Save.
Members list → pick a member → 'Resend invite'. Idempotent.
pitfalls: You cannot dissolve a committee that has already voted — archive it instead.
Committee invite emails expire after 7 days; 'Resend' generates a new token.

title: Admin console · Escrow (EMD)
purpose: Joint-signature Earnest Money Deposit escrow — accounts + transactions with dual-officer approval.
fields: One row per notice — balance, currency, joint officers, status.
Assigns two officers (must be different people) + currency.
Every deposit / release / refund with dual-signature status.
Each officer clicks 'Sign' via their own login. Money only moves when both signed.
Auto-triggered on bid rejection / notice cancellation.
tutorial: Escrow → Accounts → '+ New' → pick notice + Officer A + Officer B + currency → Save.
Transactions → pick pending row → Officer A signs → Officer B signs → funds move.
api: Each officer signs via own session.
pitfalls: Officer A and Officer B cannot be the same person — 400 enforced.
SLA threshold on pending transactions is exposed on the Stakeholder → Escrow report.

title: Admin console · Evaluation & scoring
purpose: Rubric editor + technical/commercial lock + COI declaration + award report.
fields: Freezes technical scores — no further edits.
Generates the QCBS award report PDF.
Evaluator ticks 'has conflict?' + optional note → captured to audit.
tutorial: Evaluation → Rubric editor → add criteria + weights (must sum to 100).
Bid score list → pick bid → enter score per criterion → Save.
'Lock technical' → confirm. Once locked no evaluator can edit.
pitfalls: Locking is one-way — only Master Admin can unlock via an audit-logged override.

title: Admin console · Awards & POs
purpose: Awarded bids + Purchase Order generation. Regenerate is guarded by a confirmation modal + versions all previous POs.
fields: Bid ref · vendor · award amount · PO ref · pdf link.
Reruns the PDF generator with a new version. Old PDFs are preserved.
Every generated PO version with timestamp + actor.

title: Admin console · DocuSign · Envelope log
purpose: Every DocuSign envelope, its status, and the authoritative flag marking the legally-binding version.
fields: Only ONE envelope per contract can be authoritative — enforced with a 409 on second set.
api: 409 if already set on another envelope.
pitfalls: Marking authoritative twice is intentional 409 — the second call must first unmark the first.

title: Admin console · Reverse auctions
purpose: Live reverse auctions — draft link hidden from public, participant validation, real-time price ticker.
fields: Only bidders whose bid is escrow_accepted can be added — validated.

title: Admin console · Meetings
purpose: Zoom / internal meeting scheduling. notice_ref required unless 'Internal meeting' toggle is on.
fields: Title · date · attendees · Zoom URL (optional) · notice_ref.
If ticked, notice_ref becomes optional. Used for internal ops.
Optional. If present, appears on the invite email.

title: Admin console · L1 comparison
purpose: Lowest-compliant winner across bids. Empty-state includes 'why L1 could not be picked' reasons.
fields: e.g. 'No commercial envelope locked' or 'All bidders non-compliant on eligibility'.
api: Returns comparison + winner or empty-state reason.

title: Admin console · BOQ & contracts
purpose: BOQ templates + Contract templates with exports + versions.
fields: Import a BOQ from a spreadsheet.
PDF + XLSX export of a template.

title: BOQ · Contracts sub-tab
purpose: Contract templates — the boilerplate clauses linked to award PO generation.

title: Admin console · Vendor Intelligence
purpose: Blacklist / whitelist / grey-list registry with a KPI decorator per vendor.
fields: BL red · WL green · Grey amber.
On the vendors master, a coloured pill from Vendor Intel.

title: Admin console · Masters · Staff
purpose: Staff master — seed reviewers, escrow agents, certifiers, legal, accounting, committee, auditor.
fields: Staff master · Companies · Tenants · Approval matrix · Hierarchy.
Name · email · role(s) · designation · active toggle.
Sends a recover-token email to the staff member.

title: Masters · Companies
purpose: Tenant-scoped company catalog — internal companies (departments, subsidiaries) that own contracts.

title: Masters · Approval matrix
purpose: The dynamic approval matrix editor. Each row is a step (role + action + SLA hours).
fields: # · Role picker · Action text · SLA hours · move up/down · delete.
List of all matrices with steps × applies-to.
tutorial: Escrow accept EMD → Admin flag → Certifier site inspection → Legal KYC → Accounting sign-off → Committee award. SLAs typically 24 / 24 / 72 / 48 / 24 / 168 h.
Use the up/down arrows in the Move column.
In Notice → 'Approval matrix' → pick the matrix from this list.

title: Masters · Hierarchy
purpose: Level 0..3 hierarchy — the enforcement backbone of G2 access control.
fields: Draft + approve up to threshold; cannot publish.

title: Masters · Tenants
purpose: Multi-tenant registry. Every tenant has a code + name + kind + theme.
fields: Provisions a new tenant. Also seeds a default admin.

title: Admin console · Permissions matrix (G2)
purpose: Effective role permissions — the merged view of Permissions Matrix + Hierarchy Level.
fields: Pick a role to inspect its effective permissions.
Every tab × every action (view / create / edit / publish / approve / delete).
Displays the current Level for the picked role.
pitfalls: Editing this grid affects live sessions — users see the new permissions on next request (no re-login needed).

title: Admin console · Package tracker
purpose: Kanban of packages by stage. Drag a card between columns to move it forward.
fields: Backlog · In progress · Review · Blocked · Done.
Package title · owner · SLA countdown · linked notice_ref.
Modal — title, owner, notice_ref, target date.
Click any card → drawer with sub-tasks + timeline + audit log.

title: Admin console · Audit log
purpose: Every substantive action across the portal — actor · tenant · IP · user-agent · timestamp.
fields: By actor · action type · entity · date range.
Timestamp · actor · action · entity_ref · detail JSON.

title: Admin console · Product catalog
purpose: Product / service SKU master used by the Engagements pipeline.
fields: code · name · price · currency · active toggle.
Every price update audit-logged with actor.

title: Admin console · Engagements (quotes pipeline)
purpose: Quote requests → engagements. Aging buckets + cancel-with-reason.
fields: Buyer name — click to jump to Vendors (Bug EN-03).

title: Admin console · Reports · Asked-vs-delivered
purpose: Asked-vs-delivered dashboard + printable flowcharts.

title: Admin console · Stakeholder reports (G4)
purpose: Stakeholder-facing reports — Tenders / Awards / Escrow / SLA. Downloadable CSV per tab.
fields: Full export of the current tab.
Only on Escrow tab — shows the threshold config.

title: Admin console · Help requests triage
purpose: Inbound help-form triage. Assign / resolve / close.

title: Admin console · Portal branding
purpose: Per-tenant logo history + primary/secondary theme colours. Live-preview panel.
fields: Every uploaded logo — click to restore an old one.
Shows the top-bar + a sample button using the new theme.
Applies theme instantly to all tenant users.

title: Stakeholder reports · Tenders
purpose: Stakeholder-facing tenders report table.

title: Stakeholder reports · Awards
purpose: Stakeholder-facing awards report table.

title: Stakeholder reports · Escrow
purpose: Stakeholder-facing escrow report table.

title: Stakeholder reports · Sla
purpose: Stakeholder-facing sla report table.

title: Vendor portal · Dashboard
purpose: Vendor home — Open tenders (browse + bid) · My bids · Signatures.
fields: Every published notice with a 'Submit bid' CTA.
Every bid you've submitted with its stage + AI compare status.
Every DocuSign envelope you need to counter-sign.
GDPR forget — anonymises your account in-place.
tutorial: Open tenders tab → click 'Submit bid' on any card → land on /vendor/bid/new/:ref.
My bids tab → each row shows the pipeline stage (emd_pending, escrow_accepted, admin_flagged, awarded…).
Signatures tab → click a pending row → land on the DocuSign hosted page.

title: Vendor · Change password
purpose: Rotate the vendor password. Same rules as admin (12 / 1U / 1D / 1S).
pitfalls: If must_change_password is true, no other route works until this succeeds.

title: Vendor · Purchase services
purpose: Buy add-on services (KYC upgrade, priority support). Stripe checkout.

title: Vendor · Sandbox checkout
purpose: Test payment page (sandbox mode) — used when Stripe is not configured.

title: Vendor · Payment success
purpose: Post-payment confirmation and receipt link.

title: Vendor · Payment cancelled
purpose: Cancellation notice with a retry CTA.

title: Staff portal · Dashboard
purpose: Role-scoped task inbox. Escrow agents see pending signatures; certifiers see site-inspection tasks; legal sees KYC reviews; accounting sees sign-offs.
fields: Task type · notice_ref · SLA countdown · CTA.
api: Assigned tasks for the current staff user.
